summary.interpretation: Official multilingual-e5-large retrieval recipe on the same Skt+Eng documents and frozen 100 questions: query:/passage: prefixes, normalize_embeddings=True, FAISS IndexFlatIP. Bundled recipe test, not a single-variable ablation.
summary.prefixes: query: on questions; passage: on documents (encode-time only)
summary.distance: IndexFlatIP / MAX_INNER_PRODUCT (higher is closer). Unit vectors so IP = cosine.

per_question.question: Where did Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana settle after they continued their exile journey on foot?
When Rama was leaving for exile, how long did he tell his father it would be before they saw each other again?
How did the elders in the assembly react when Yudhishthira staked Draupadi in the dice game?
After Arjuna broke the brothers' household rule, how long did he go to live in the forest?
Where was Duryodhana hiding after the Kurukshetra battle?
When Draupadi was being comforted after the dice-game insult, who did her brother say would kill Drona, Bhishma, Duryodhana, and Karna?
According to Vidura, why was Duryodhana unwilling to make peace when Krishna came as an envoy?
In the teaching about Death, what is said to happen to people after the body is destroyed?
If a king is weaker than a neighbor, how does Bhishma say he may still attack that stronger kingdom?
When Bhishma defends giving Krishna the highest honor, what does he say about Krishna's place in the universe?
Which female demon did Vishvamitra tell Rama was terrorizing the region they were about to pass through?
While Vasistha stood with the Brahmanas before Dasaratha, what immediate order did he ask the king to give concerning Rama?
When Rama entered to see Dasaratha about the coronation, whom did he find sitting with his father, and how did the king look?
On the day people had dressed for Rama's installation, what did those present notice about Rama's face?
When Rama was getting Sita onto the river raft, what belongings did he place beside her?
After leaving his counselors behind, whom did Bharata go to visit, following the family priest?
After Sita was abducted, at which lake did Rama begin to lament while walking with Lakshmana?
In Sugriva's search orders, where were the monkeys told to look together for Rama's wife?
During the search for Sita, what does this counsel say happens to people who keep acting, compared with people who give in to grief?
What object, stored in its case, did Janaka's counselors bring when they approached the king?
When Sita was heard weeping in the forest, whom did the young rishis go to tell?
In this teaching spoken to Rama, whose life is called happy, and whose life unhappy?
What two things did Sugriva promise Rama he would regain after seeing Rama's grief?
Where did Janaka say his brother Kusadhvaja ruled, and what river washed that city?
According to Sugriva, why was extra help unnecessary for Rama in battle?
When the rest of the monkeys had lost heart at the ocean, whom did the speaker urge not to ignore their despair?
After leaving the northern direction, toward which quarter did the great muni go to perform severe austerities?
According to Jabali's argument to Rama, should a wise person form lasting attachment to family and household?
Which of Shantanu and Satyavati's sons inherited the throne after the other was slain by Gandharvas before adulthood?
How did Duryodhana propose to buy Drupada's court away from Yudhishthira's side?
After Krishna had spoken as a friend seeking peace, what did Bhishma tell Duryodhana not to follow instead?
According to Kunti, what livelihood belongs to each of the four social orders?
According to the snake who spoke with Bhima, what three kinds of rebirth can a person's own acts produce?
In Sanatsujata's teaching, what is named as one kind of death, what as another, and what is identified with immortality?
In Krishna's battlefield teaching to Arjuna, what kind of person is said to attain peace?
Before the war, what did Bhishma tell the Pandavas he would still give them, and what did he say he would not do for their side?
After Bhishma had spoken to Duryodhana from the bed of arrows, what did he then do despite his wounds?
After Bhishma, Drona, Karna, Jayadratha, Duryodhana's brothers, and Lakshmana had fallen, what question did Kripa raise about continuing?
When Yudhishthira was leaving for the forest after the dice game, which elders did he formally bid farewell to first?
What long-sought purpose did Kirmira say had brought him roaming armed across the world?
During the fight at Saubha, what did Krishna say he started doing with his arrows to the enemies of the gods?
What gift from Airavata's pair of bells did Indra present to Skanda?
When Kunti invoked Surya, what did she keep gazing at without growing tired of its beauty?
In Virata's court, what physical insult did Draupadi say the suta's son had given her?
Where in Virata's palace did Draupadi find Bhima waiting?
Just before Kurukshetra, why did the earth become crowded with kings?
Instead of fighting, what did Krishna propose the visiting kings do together before returning to their own countries?
What amazed Dhritarashtra about his own heart after he heard that Bhishma had been slain?
On that morning of battle, which Kaurava leaders did Shikhandin attack with Virata, and which leaders did Arjuna attack?
After Arjuna slew Bhagadatta, what did he then do to the rest of the Kaurava warriors?
After Arjuna challenged Ashvatthaman, what did Krishna do with Arjuna?
After Duryodhana had fallen, what mistake did the speaker say Yudhishthira had made about deciding the war?
Why was Dhritarashtra told not to grieve for the slain Kuru heroes?
After Yudhishthira had won the kingdom by Kshatriya duty, why did Arjuna ask him not to keep grieving?
According to this teaching on enmity, why is it unsafe to rely on an old enemy's friendly words?
According to this teaching, what food do sages who live by penance refuse?
According to Vidura, which four religious practices meant to take away fear instead cause fear if they are performed wrongly?
After Vyasa spoke to him, what did Dhritarashtra tell Yudhishthira about his own grief?
When Vyasa arrived at the snake sacrifice, what kind of seat did the king offer him?
In the Shishupala episode, how did some of the assembled warriors describe Bhishma after he had spoken?
After the dice-game injuries, why did the speaker say the Pandavas would not forgive the Kauravas?
If Nala did not want to play dice, what alternative contest did Pushkara propose to settle their quarrel?
In this description, to which two Vrishni heroes is Arjuna said to be equal?
Besides restoring Indradyumna to heaven, whom did Markandeya say Krishna had rescued from hell?
Whom did Brihadashva install on the throne when the time came?
After Dharma spoke at the lake, what happened to him, and what happened to the Pandava brothers?
In the story of Indra's defeat, whom was the lady told to choose as husband instead of Indra, and why?
In this address, what role is Agni said to play inside every creature regarding right and wrong?
With which companions did Balarama enter the Pandava camp?
According to this Gita teaching, what is said of a person without egoism whose mind is unsullied, even if he kills many people?
According to Sanjaya, what was Bhishma trying to protect by fighting so hard that morning?
What reminder is given here about Karna's earlier defeat, along with the Kaurava army, during the year the Pandavas spent in disguise?
In the Galava story, what son did Madhavi bear to Vishvamitra?
How did Jarasandha say he was willing to fight Krishna, Bhima, and Arjuna?
In Karna's description of the coming war as a sacrifice, what role did he assign to Ghatotkacha, and at what time?
When Satyavan collapsed, what did Savitri begin to calculate, and whose earlier warning did she remember?
According to this rebuke of Arjuna, what would happen if boasting were enough to make a person succeed?
After Yudhishthira killed Shalya, to what old victory was the army's praise of him compared?
Who did Yudhishthira say could endure the Brahmastras of Drona and Karna, when even Indra could not?
According to Arjuna, when Duryodhana sees Dhrishtadyumna seated among the Srinjayas, what will Duryodhana do?
According to the wise, what happens even to sinful people who bathe at Prithudaka?
When Jayadratha fled after seizing Draupadi, how did Bhima catch him?
What three hardships did Baka say even the deathless still have to endure?
What did Sharmishtha ask king Yayati to do so that she could become a mother?
When Arjuna came forward, what made the Kaurava side freeze with fear?
After Rahu's head was cut off, what enmity began, and what does that head still do to the sun and moon?
What fate did Kashyapa say was coming that very day for king Parikshit?
What did Shiva tell Drupada his child would first be, and what would that child later become?
What future was predicted for the son Shakuntala would bear to Dushyanta?
What did Bhima promise Hidimba's sister he would do to the rakshasa while she watched?
What did Dhritarashtra tell Duryodhana about revealing his thoughts to Vidura?
In the Naga house, what rite did Arjuna perform at the fire, and how did Agni respond?
When Agni asked Arjuna for help burning the Khandava forest, what problem did Arjuna say he had with his bow?
When the Khandava forest was burning, how did the young Sharangaka birds hope to reach the higher worlds?
Where did Krishna say he found Shalva standing with the Saubha car?
When Bhima urged action in the forest, what did Yudhishthira say about controlling the mind and about what had already happened?
After Pushkara cheated Nala at dice, where did Nala go to live, and who went with him?
In this prophecy of a coming age, how many suns are said to appear, and what then happens on every side?
When the ocean rose around them, which island did the snakes reach together with their mother?
Who served as the Hota priest at Janamejaya's snake sacrifice, and from which lineage did he come?
